statistic: Per-cell median/min/max of 3 whole-burst TPS values. Latency medians are medians of the 3 repeat quantiles; no pooled quantiles or cross-workload score.
cache_policy: cold KV; distinct request salts; cached_tokens must be zero
change_definition: (16K median / corresponding 32K median - 1) * 100; positive TPS is higher throughput, negative latency is shorter.
